message:
[Page 3] Money: tools, budgets and spend Lena Ortiz owns our tools list: every software seat and vendor, what it costs a year and when it renews. Each team has a budget for the quarter, and Lena tracks what is spent against it. Tool owners are reminded a month before a tool renews. Expenses and purchases go through Spend. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category; Lena approves them and marks them paid. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval. Each person sees their own spend; Lena and Wade see all of it. Time off: people request it, their manager approves or declines, and it is marked taken once the days have passed. Lena keeps everyone's yearly balance. [Page 4] Customers We have 12 customer contracts. Each has an owner at Fernwood, a yearly value, a start date, a renewal date and a notice period. A contract starts as a draft, is signed, becomes active, and comes up for renewal; then it is renewed or ended. The owner is reminded 60 days before the notice date, and the contract moves to renewal due. When a contract comes up for renewal, a request starts in Spend for the budget owner, so the renewal is budgeted. Some contracts have a customer contact at the customer; they are not Fernwood people. Questions about this write-up go to Krishna. [Page 4] Expense policy Every expense needs a receipt and a category before it can be approved. The categories are Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training and Other. Lena Ortiz approves or rejects every submitted expense. Nobody approves their own expense. Team meals are paid up to $40 a person. Expenses are paid with the next payroll once approved. [Page 8] Expense policy (continued) Receipts are kept with the expense. An expense without a receipt waits on the person who submitted it until the receipt is attached. [Page 9] Purchasing policy Purchases are requested in Spend and approved before they are ordered. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval; Lena approves the rest. A purchase moves from requested to approved, ordered and received. [Page 11] Budgets Each team has a budget per quarter. Spending counts against the budget of the person's team. Tables attached (name, header and row count; the cells are data too): "Expense ID","Date","Employee Email","Merchant","Description","Amount","Category","Receipt","Status","Project Code"
Latest message from Wade Wilson: Set up Spend: Expenses, purchases and renewal requests. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category (Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other). Lena approves or rejects them and marks them paid with the next payroll. Purchases are requested, approved, ordered and received. Renewal requests from Customer contracts also land here. Each person sees their own spend; Lena and Wade see all of it. Its rules, from the policies: - An expense without a receipt waits on the person who submitted it until the receipt is attached. - Lena approves or rejects every submitted expense, and nobody approves their own. - Once an expense is approved, Lena marks it paid with the next payroll. - A purchase over $2,000 waits for Krishna's approval before it is ordered. - Lena approves purchases of $2,000 or less. - Team meals are paid up to $40 a person. Its rows come from expenses.csv, imported into its first sheet. The file's columns fill plain columns of that sheet (text, dates, amounts, people, choices, steps); a link can't be filled from a file, so a link column there stays empty for imported rows.
